svg.text: PLACEHOLDER: replace me with your drawing
When it is seen: efficiency measurement (input, output, load, datalogger). One image for all
What to draw: from left to right: the input power supply, the converter under test, the
electronic load. Between the power supply and the converter a shunt in series on the positive
(to measure the input current). The datalogger below, with three wires going to: the input
voltage (upstream of the shunt, near the converter input), the shunt ends (input current) and
the output voltage (at the load terminals or at the converter output).
Details: short labels, the same in all languages: VIN, IIN, VOUT, GND; do not write the
datalogger channel numbers: they change from one file to another (the numbered list, written
from the file, gives them). An auxiliary power supply (for the control of the converter) drawn
dashed, because it is not always there.
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
